records.requires: Actual edible rabbit carcass, cuts or offals under FSSR 2.5.2(6); match as-sampled tissue and species, test method, valid amendments and risk-relevant analytes. These veterinary limits do not substitute metal/pesticide/microbiology requirements.
records.forbidden_inheritance: Never borrow cattle, sheep, poultry or goat-specific veterinary/metal limits; all other source omissions remain unresolved.

records.requires: Evidence that final finished casing is edible animal-derived intestinal, oesophageal or bladder tissue under FSSR 2.5.2(14), actual slaughtered food-animal species, process (dried or wet salted), test basis and regulator-approved carry-through of tissue veterinary limit to processed casing.
records.forbidden_inheritance: A processed sausage casing is not automatically an unprocessed edible animal tissue residue sample. 20 rows are conditional references, not assigned limits.

records.requires: Evidence whether finished egg powder/frozen/liquid/pickled product legally remains in the CTR 'Poultry and egg' article after separation, pasteurisation, drying, freezing or pickling; confirm test basis, ingredients, amendments and applicability.
records.forbidden_inheritance: Do not borrow animal-tissue veterinary limits for eggs, nor apply poultry/egg 0.01 mg/kg automatically to processed egg matrices.
